Loss report: gitlab -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.api (Tekton has no API trigger kind; only an EventListener entry of a Tekton file is kept)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered/step/script step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
